EasyUse Anima 1.0.2 fixes Prompt Corrector artist recognition and stale Prompt Studio highlights after paste.

Changes:
1. Explicit @artist tags are kept in the artist section without also being reported as unknown when artist validation is disabled.
2. Prompt Studio Classic, Advanced, Advanced V2, and Regional highlights no longer reuse classification from earlier text after paste or rapid replacement.
3. Existing artist overrides, exclusions, prompt ordering, workflow data, and the unknown-tag policy for general or natural-language text remain compatible.

Action required:
After updating, restart ComfyUI and hard-refresh the browser.
